BiblicalUsage: Yâphêach means puffing, breathing out, and it is used of false witnesses who breathe out cruelty. David prays not to be given over to their will, because their breath is violence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe lies have a breath, and God sees the cruelty behind the testimony.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
